source_text: Three major RCTs conducted between 2005 and 2007—one in South Africa showing 60% efficacy, one in Kenya with 53%, and one in Uganda with 51%—provided high-quality evidence prompting World Health Organization recommendations for voluntary medical male circumcision in high-prevalence settings.
